reuse.why: Introduces one exported isHoliday helper built on the existing monthUtils.dayFromDate and replaces every inline `holidays.includes(dayFromDate(...))` check in shared/schedules.ts and schedules/app.ts with it.

duplication.why: The five copies of the holiday membership test are collapsed into one function; the surrounding `isWeekend(date) || isHoliday(date, holidays)` pairing is still repeated at those five sites, which a single non-working-day predicate would have removed.

placement.why: The helper lives in shared/schedules.ts with the other schedule date rules and is imported by the server app; it is placed at the top of the file among the preset constants rather than next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Only the holiday matching and its tests change.

maintainability.why: The MM-DD vs YYYY-MM-DD rule now has one definition that every holiday check uses; the remaining weekend-or-holiday composition at each site is the main thing a maintainer would still have to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks in the tree (getNextDate x2, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) now call isHoliday

disguised_duplication.where: The previous inline copies were replaced by calls, not reshaped
